title: find-the-losers-of-the-circular-game
oracle_code:
def oracle(input):
    n = input['n']
    k = input['k']
    seen = [False] * (n + 1)
    cur = 1
    seen[cur] = True
    step = 1
    while True:
        nxt = ((cur - 1 + step * k) % n) + 1
        if seen[nxt]:
            break
        seen[nxt] = True
        cur = nxt
        step += 1
    ans = []
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        if not seen[i]:
            ans.append(i)
        i += 1
    return ans

title: apps_1489
oracle_code:
def oracle(input):
    MOD = 1000000007
    n = input[0]
    pts = input[1]
    x_to_id = {}
    y_to_id = {}
    x_cnt = 0
    y_cnt = 0
    edges = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        x = pts[i][0]
        y = pts[i][1]
        if x in x_to_id:
            xi = x_to_id[x]
        else:
            xi = x_cnt
            x_to_id[x] = xi
            x_cnt += 1
        if y in y_to_id:
            yi = y_to_id[y]
        else:
            yi = y_cnt
            y_to_id[y] = yi
            y_cnt += 1
        edges.append([xi, yi])
        i += 1

    total_nodes = x_cnt + y_cnt
    adj = []
    i = 0
    while i < total_nodes:
        adj.append([])
        i += 1
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        xi = edges[i][0]
        yi = edges[i][1] + x_cnt
        adj[xi].append(yi)
        adj[yi].append(xi)
        i += 1

    visited = []
    i = 0
    while i < total_nodes:
        visited.append(False)
        i += 1

    def mod_pow(a, b):
        res = 1
        a %= MOD
        while b > 0:
            if b % 2 == 1:
                res = (res * a) % MOD
            a = (a * a) % MOD
            b //= 2
        return res

    ans = 1
    s = 0
    while s < total_nodes:
        if not visited[s]:
            stack = [s]
            visited[s] = True
            vcnt = 0
            deg_sum = 0
            while stack:
                v = stack.pop()
                vcnt += 1
                deg_sum += len(adj[v])
                j = 0
                while j < len(adj[v]):
                    to = adj[v][j]
                    if not visited[to]:
                        visited[to] = True
                        stack.append(to)
                    j += 1
            ecnt = deg_sum // 2
            term = (mod_pow(2, vcnt) - 1 - ecnt) % MOD
            ans = (ans * term) % MOD
        s += 1
    return ans
